title: ForgeOS planning Capability ownership projection v1
description: Closed projection envelope for complete primary-owner coverage and declared logical adapter references derived from two caller-supplied exact planning YAML byte strings.
$comment: JSON Schema is structural only. A conforming projector must strictly decode the embedded RFC 4648 base64, bind and parse the exact raw YAML bytes with the frozen subset below, enforce complete and unique ownership, derive every field and digest, and preserve the authority-neutral planning-only boundary.

positive_result.const: PROJECTED_PLANNING_CAPABILITY_OWNERSHIP_ONLY (complete declared primary-owner coverage and logical adapter references for the supplied planning sources only; no file existence, Skill availability, Registry mutation, authentication, authorization, permission, invocation, routing, execution, persistence, transition, or effect attestation)

x-forgeos-yaml-source-profile.blank_line_handling: blank physical lines are skipped at document start, between block entries, and between a block key colon end-of-line or bare dash and its next nonblank exactly indented child; a blank line terminates folded content
x-forgeos-yaml-source-profile.mapping_keys: after complete no-escape double-quoted key decoding or as a plain key, every key matches [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*, is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes, and << is forbidden

x-forgeos-yaml-source-profile.plain_scalar_lexical_rule: after block syntax-prefix removal a non-typed plain-string fallback is nonempty, has no edge padding, is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes, has no leading byte in -?:,[]{}#&*!|>'%@`, has no trailing colon, and has no double quote; flow skips or trims ASCII spaces at token edges and preserves interior spaces
